decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message INTRODUCE that fully captures the required lighting and its cool, fun, inviting DJ-style purpose.
The candidate already has a same-message INTRODUCE covering DJ-inspired knobs, measurement units around the bowls, and related visual detailing.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY requiring text and logos based on the CAD renderings; the source adds no further branding change.
The general request to include color as shown in the CAD renderings does not replace or modify the established beige-and-green color values.
The statement that functionality remains important does not change any specific mixing-quality criterion.
Measurement units around the bowls are visual detailing and do not change bowl capacity or physical form.
The visual-character decision does not alter the approved component set, BOM obligations, or component-selection criteria.
The stronger DJ-style visual direction does not necessarily change the current V1 sourcing policy or its existing custom-fabrication exceptions.
The source does not change the spout's geometry, orientation, construction, or beverage-quality constraints.
Requesting stronger visual treatment based on prior CAD renderings does not change the system-layout or CAD deliverable state.
The visual-identity change does not modify the finalized wiring-plan deliverable.
Mentioning knobs as visual DJ-style details does not change the button-operated dispensing mechanism or its flow behavior.
